title: Analysis code for: Design-Based Explainable Machine Learning for Computer and Information Literacy across 35 Education Systems in ICILS 2023

creators.name: Yıldırım, Nuray
creators.affiliation: Vocational School of Social Sciences, Firat University, Elazig, Turkey

creators.name: Katar, Oğuzhan
creators.affiliation: Department of Software Engineering, Firat University, Elazig, Turkey

description: Analysis code and aggregated system-level results for the article Design-Based Explainable Machine Learning for Computer and Information Literacy across 35 Education Systems in ICILS 2023 (Applied Sciences). The pipeline compares four model classes under nested school-grouped cross-validation in all 35 education systems of ICILS 2023, recomputes SHAP statistics of XGBoost for every plausible value and every jackknife replicate weight so that each explanation carries a design-based standard error, sets them against design-based linear benchmarks, pools them by random-effects meta-analysis, and evaluates transfer, group calibration and the variance estimators themselves. The ICILS 2023 microdata are not included; they are available from the IEA (https://doi.org/10.58150/ICILS_2023_data_2).
